title: Graduate Data Scientist
text: Graduate Data Scientist at WesTrac Pty Ltd (Newcastle, Maitland & Hunter, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). About the Role We are currently seeking a results driven and energetic Graduate Data Scientist to join our dedicated Product Support Sales team located at our NSW Head Office based in Tomago. Reporting to the Product Support Sales Manager you will be responsible for assisting the Product Support Sales Team to grow parts sales through development and ongoing management of customer loyalty agreements, particularly within the markets of Construction and Commercial Engines. This is an integral position within the business and will have a specific focus on data analysis and analytics to drive business efficiencies coupled with a marketing focus. You will work closely with the Digital Marketing team, Business Intelligence and E Business teams to review and build a data platform to drive visualisation of the marketing campaigns to identify opportunities and trends within our industry to increase sales and lower costs. What we’re looking for Tertiary qualifications in Business, Engineering or equivalent related degree Advanced computer literacy skills Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage fluctuating workloads and conflicting priorities to achieve tight deadlines Excellent communication skills (verbal, written and interpersonal) with the ability to effectively liaise at a high level with customers and a diverse range of interdepartmental team members Demonstrated attention to detail, ability to analyse problems and provide appropriate solutions Knowledge of the heavy equipment industry his highly desirable however not essential You are a results driven individual who is easily motivated by success. Your proactive approach to your work coupled with your ability to prioritise your workload will see you thrive in this role. The team at WesTrac encourages growth and development of our staff and this is an outstanding opportunity to grow and develop your career with a globally recognised Caterpillar dealership. About us WesTrac Pty Ltd is an Equipment Management business and one of the world's leading Caterpillar Dealerships, operating in NSW, ACT and WA. Our primary focus is our people. We know that our success is the result of more than 3,000 talented people working together to achieve amazing outcomes. Now as we look to the future, we're more focused than ever on harnessing the best talent for our business. The WesTrac culture is about energy, enthusiasm, contribution and being able to make a difference in what we do at work and beyond. You will be able to maximise value whilst continuing the investment we have in our most important asset, our people. WesTrac offers various employee benefits including company funded income protection, salary packaging options, corporate private health plan, and a Fitness Passport allowing access to over 200+ gyms and pools at discounted rates. Our Newcastle branch has an on-site cafeteria along with employee parking. Make the move with an industry leader today! Apply today This is a challenging yet rewarding role with a competitive salary package on offer based on your experience. You will also have the opportunity to work with talented people and build a strong career. If you believe you have skills and experience to make this role a success, please apply via the link. WesTrac will be at The National Diesel, Dirt & Turf Expo on April 13-15 (Penrith) – come and say hello for assistance with Careers, Caterpillar and all things WesTrac!
